name: World Bank Indicators API (v2)
dataKind: Annual country and world economic and trade indicators (historical statistics)
browserAccessNote: A cross-origin request from a browser was blocked: the API sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (tested 2026-11-17). eport therefore does not call it from the page.
coverage: Around 200 economies plus the world aggregate; coverage varies by indicator and year. Missing observations are left missing.
freshness: Annual observations. Each figure shows the World Bank's database update date and the date eport retrieved it.
attribution: Source: World Bank, World Development Indicators.
rateLimit: Not applicable at runtime — four requests per snapshot refresh.
usedBy: Home and Intelligence: world trade indicators
notes: Retrieved at build time and published as dated static files, as the CC BY 4.0 licence permits. Values are historical statistics, not live data; the publisher may revise recent years.

name: Frankfurter
dataKind: Daily reference exchange rates published by central banks
browserAccessNote: A cross-origin request from a browser succeeded; the response carries Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (tested 2026-11-17).
coverage: Currencies with published central-bank reference rates; not every ISO 4217 currency. eport checks the provider's currency list before requesting a rate.
freshness: Updated on working days. Reference rates only — not tradable, bank or customs rates.
license: Open-source service; underlying rates published by central banks.
rateLimit: No API key or published quota. eport caches rates in the browser for 6 hours and the currency list for 7 days.
usedBy: Planned: Trade Cost Explorer currency conversion (Phase 3)
notes: Called live from the browser. Your browser sends only the currency codes being requested.

name: Digitraffic Marine
dataKind: AIS vessel locations and metadata, port calls
browserAccessNote: Response carried Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (checked 2026-11-17). The service requires gzip, which browsers send by default.
coverage: Vessels received by Finnish AIS base stations — the Baltic Sea around Finland only. Not global coverage.
freshness: Near real time for vessels inside the coverage area.
attribution: Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, licence CC BY 4.0.
rateLimit: Published fair-use limits apply; a Digitraffic-User identification header is requested by the operator.
usedBy: Planned: Maritime Intelligence regional vessel layer (Phase 4)
notes: When integrated, eport will label this as regional coverage. It must never be presented as a global vessel feed.

name: UN Comtrade API
dataKind: Bilateral merchandise trade statistics by HS commodity
browserAccessNote: The keyless preview endpoint returned no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (checked 2026-11-17). Full access needs a subscription key, which cannot be placed in a static site.
coverage: Most reporting economies; detailed bilateral flows by commodity.
freshness: Annual and monthly, as reported by national statistical offices.
notes: Coming Soon — requires a secure integration layer. Until then eport links users to the official UN Comtrade website.

name: AISHub
browserAccessNote: Not tested: access requires membership and a personal credential, which cannot be placed in a static site.
notes: Coming Soon — requires a secure integration layer and a data-sharing membership.
